extension.summary: Listen to the audiobooks on your Audiobookshelf server
extension.description: Sign in with your Audiobookshelf username and password and browse your library from the couch: Continue Listening, Recently Added, all books, series in reading order, authors, genres and search, with cover art and progress on every book. Can't decide? Play a random book, from the whole library or from one genre. Books play in Kodi's own player, resume where you left off on any device, start from any chapter, and report your listening progress back to the server while you listen. Needs an Audiobookshelf server (2.26 or later); an API key works too.
extension.disclaimer: Not affiliated with the Audiobookshelf project. Your server address, username and password are stored in Kodi's add-on settings on this device.
